newsitem.title: FRANCE: Unions call strike over French civil service pay.
newsitem.headline: Unions call strike over French civil service pay.

text.p: French civil service unions called a one-day strike for March 6 after rejecting a government pay offer made on Tuesday to millions of public sector employees.

"The seven union federations call on civil servants to take part massively in a day of national action, strike and protest rallies on March 6," CGT civil service union leader Bernard Lhubert said, reading from a joint union communique.
"(The unions) call on the government to open genuine talks on their demands," said the communique which Lhubert read to reporters after the unions met to decide their response.
Civil Service Minister Dominique Perben announced an offer of a pay rise of a total 2.8 percent for 1997 and 1998.

But unions rejected the offer, mainly on the grounds that it did not meet their key demand for additional money to compensate for a pay freeze in 1996 for staff in the state administration, local authorities, education and health services.
